description:
The selected vendor will be responsible for the sourcing, management, and timely delivery of all items listed in Attachment 1 for OCONUS orders to Costal Pacific Food Distribution, Inc in Stockton, CA. Key capabilities include:

  • Product Sourcing: Ability to procure the specified commercial items.
  • Logistics & Distribution: A robust supply chain capable of providing reliable, on-time delivery to a container point in Stockton, CA.
  • Quality Control: Ensuring all products meet the specifications outlined in the attachment.
